title: Canonical data for the open-object cohomology comparison
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion] and let $G$ be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Write $A_j$ for the free abelian sheaf on the universe-lifted representable of $j$, namely the value at $j$ of the already constructed functor [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map]. Construct $A_j\cong j_!\mathbf Z_U$ by the natural additive identifications of both Hom functors with $G(j)$, using [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Construct the comparison $e_j^q:\operatorname{Ext}^q_X(A_j,G)\cong H^q(U,j^*G)$ [def-pc-ext, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] by inverse precomposition with this representing isomorphism and the inverse exact Ext adjunction [lem-sc-ext-exact-adjunction]. These are specified constructions, not choices from the existence of equivalences. The comparison commutes with morphisms of $G$. For a further open inclusion $k:V\to U$, define the global cohomology restriction as inverse-image cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] followed by the canonical composition and inverse-image/restriction identifications [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction], so its target is $H^q(V,(k\circ j)^*G)$.

proof.text: Use the existing exact extension-by-zero/restriction adjunction on abelian etale sheaves, Etale.openImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction and preservesFiniteLimits_openImmersionLowerShriek. Restriction also has a right adjoint, localizationRestrictionLowerStarAdjunction, hence is exact. This is precisely the mechanism of Stacks 03F3, without constructing the intermediate slice-site comparison.

Let A_j be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on uliftYoneda(j). The sheafification/free-abelian/ulift-Yoneda adjunction identifies Hom(A_j,G) additively with G(j). The extension-by-zero adjunction and the constant-sheaf adjunction at id_U identify Hom(j_! Z_U,G) with the same sections. The iso mk(id_U composed with j) to mk(j) handles the identity composition. The public EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv, restrictedSectionsEquiv, and representingHomEquiv prove these identifications and their naturality in G. Coyoneda.ext yields the actual isomorphism A_j to j_! Z_U; no arbitrary witness is chosen.

Compose inverse precomposition with representingIso and the inverse exact Ext adjunction. For coefficient naturality, apply the inverse comparison; mapExtCounit_comp_mk₀ moves the coefficient morphism across the Ext adjunction, and associativity of Ext composition moves it across the representing isomorphism.

Reuse the existing etaleOpenFreeSheaf by abbreviation. Construct the global restriction map by cohomologyMap k, then the inverse-image/restriction isomorphism at j, the inverse image composition isomorphism, and the inverse-image/restriction isomorphism at k composed with j. Every map is constructed independently of the comparison.
